title: BPMN save/load XML + diagram validation + choros moddle extension (executorType round-trip)

files_changed.purpose: bpmn-moddle JSON descriptor for the choros namespace. Extends bpmn:Activity with executorType (isAttr:true) so saveXML serialises it as choros:executorType="..." and importXML deserializes it into bo.executorType.
saveDiagram(modeler), loadDiagram(modeler,xml), validateDiagram(modeler), downloadXml(xml,filename), openXmlFilePicker(). No external deps — uses bpmn-js internals + DOMParser + FileReader.
Import ChorosModdleDescriptor and pass moddleExtensions:{choros:ChorosModdleDescriptor} to BpmnModeler constructor. This is the key registration hook.
execMarkerFor() now reads bo.executorType (moddle registered property, primary) BEFORE bo.$attrs['choros:executorType'] (legacy). Both paths checked for max compatibility.

effectiveExecType() reads bo.executorType first. handleExecTypeChange() writes BOTH bo.executorType AND bo.$attrs['choros:executorType'] — ensures saveXML sees the value via the registered property path.

Toolbar Save/Load/Validate buttons wired to handleSave/handleLoad/handleValidate handlers. ValidationBanner (errors/warnings) and SaveLoadStatusBanner (transient messages, auto-dismiss 4s) added below the toolbar. Dirty tracking via commandStack.changed EventBus event.

moddle_extension_descriptor.registration: moddleExtensions: { choros: ChorosModdleDescriptor } in BpmnModeler constructor

round_trip_proof.mechanism: With ChorosModdleDescriptor registered, bpmn-moddle treats executorType as a first-class attribute on bpmn:Activity subtypes (ServiceTask, UserTask, etc.).
round_trip_proof.parse_path: importXML reads choros:executorType="agent" from XML → bo.executorType = 'agent' (registered property, NOT $attrs)
round_trip_proof.write_path: properties panel: bo.executorType = newType AND bo.$attrs['choros:executorType'] = newType (both written for dual-path reads)
round_trip_proof.serialize_path: saveXML: moddle reads bo.executorType via element.get('executorType') → emits choros:executorType="agent" in output XML
round_trip_proof.test_result: ROUND-TRIP PRESERVED: true (task.executorType='agent' → XML contains choros:executorType="agent" → re-parsed task2.executorType='agent')

save_load_validate.save: EditorToolbar 'Сохранить' → handleSave() → saveDiagram(modeler) → modeler.saveXML({format:true}) → downloadXml(xml, '<id>.bpmn') → sets isDirty=false + shows 4s success banner
save_load_validate.load: EditorToolbar 'Загрузить' → handleLoad() → openXmlFilePicker() (input[type=file] .bpmn/.xml) → loadDiagram(modeler, xml) → modeler.importXML(xml) + fit-viewport → shows success/warning banner
save_load_validate.validate: EditorToolbar 'Проверить' → handleValidate() → validateDiagram(modeler) → [saveXML round-trip check, elementRegistry structural checks, DOMParser well-formedness] → ValidationBanner with dismissible errors/warnings

validation_checks: at least one bpmn:StartEvent in elementRegistry (error if missing)
at least one bpmn:EndEvent in elementRegistry (warning if missing)
tasks with zero incoming AND zero outgoing connections (warning per task)
